subject: Very long detailed bug report
message:
Dear Support Team,

I'm writing to report a complex issue that we've been experiencing intermittently over the past two weeks. The problem occurs specifically when using the InsightHub analytics module in conjunction with our Scrum sprint boards.

Here's what happens: When we complete a sprint and move to the retrospective view, the burndown chart shows incorrect data points for the last 3-4 days of the sprint. Specifically, the remaining work metric doesn't update when we mark subtasks as complete. This causes the burndown line to appear flat instead of declining.

We've tested this across multiple browsers (Chrome 120, Firefox 121, Safari 17) and the issue persists. We've also verified that the subtasks are indeed marked as complete in the task view and that the story points are correctly assigned.

Additionally, when we try to export the burndown chart as a PDF via InsightHub > Export, the exported chart shows different data than what's displayed on screen. The on-screen chart seems more accurate but neither matches our manual calculations.

Our team has 23 members across 3 active sprints. We're on the Professional plan. This issue started around January 28th, which coincides with what appears to be a platform update (we noticed some UI changes around that time).

Steps to reproduce:
1. Create a sprint with 10+ tasks that have subtasks
2. Complete subtasks over the course of the sprint
3. Check the burndown chart after day 7
4. Compare the chart data with manual story point calculations

Expected: Burndown reflects completed subtask story points
Actual: Burndown appears flat despite subtask completions

Could you investigate this and let us know if it's a known issue? It's significantly impacting our sprint planning accuracy.

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
Ethan Park
Scrum Master, Data Science Team
